newsitem.title: USA: Video Update to buy assets of Video View.
newsitem.headline: Video Update to buy assets of Video View.

text.p: Video Update Inc said Tuesday it will acquire the assets of Video View Ltd, a 23-store video rental chain based in Alberta, Canada.
Financial terms of the deal were not announced.

The deal is expected to strengthen Video Update's presence in Canada, where the company is already the third-largest publicly held video rental chain, said Chairman and Chief Executive Dan Potter. It will also have a significant impact on Video Update's financial performance, he added.
Video Update operates 243 company-owned video superstores in North America. It also franchises 28 video stores.
